text: Scope decisions: (a) pairing(independence='independent') default retained for 0.1 — changing it breaks the documented cross_partitions() semantics and dozens of call sites; revisit in Phase 3 (bd-01M02Q206NSX0P8SREERBFER5B) alongside the API-shape pass. (b) searchlights() default stays 'local' for now — flipping to 'conservative' changes every existing map and committed benchmark baseline; docs now warn loudly, frame_conservation() diagnostic exported, conservation covered by tests with the whole_brain('none') comparator precondition stated; default flip queued for Phase 3. (c) learned_frozen provenance: no pseudo-verification added — a fabricated 'fixed' declaration is undetectable by any signature scheme, and after the admission fix learned metrics are refused from the analytic law entirely, which is the real guard; documented rather than faked. (d) q=120 sampling scale artifact now built on a real q=120 plan with contrast-dimension and effect-name binding enforced in the kernel; benchmark rerun, committed results regenerated.
